name: GSAP
mood: Animated chalkboard for a motion library: near-black canvas, warm cream typography, massive Mori display, outlined pill buttons, curly-bracket annotations, and fixed discipline color taxonomy.

justBlack.role: Page canvas, footer surface, and deep section backgrounds.

offBlack.role: Alternative dark surface for nested panels, code blocks, and footer layers.

surface25.role: Hairline borders, dividers, and low-contrast outlines against the black canvas.

surface50.role: Muted secondary text, idle icon fills, subhead annotations, and disabled labels.

surfaceCream.role: Primary text, outlined button borders, nav links, card text, headings, and ghost controls.

gsapGreen.role: GSAP/core labels, brand marks, primary gradient stroke start, and short link accents.

lightGreen.role: Primary gradient stroke end, GSAP short accents, and secondary green highlights.

coreGreen.role: Subtle brand-tinted background washes for core feature cards.

orangey.role: SVG category label, orange tool icon fills, and orange gradient endpoints.

pink.role: Scroll category label, decorative splashes, and pink gradient endpoints.

lilac.role: Text category label, thin illustration strokes, and violet gradient endpoints.

blue.role: UI category label, blue gradient endpoints, and interface-tool accents.

lipstickPink.role: Deep decorative gradient stop only; not for text or UI.

shockinglyGreen.role: Primary CTA stroke and GSAP green taxonomy accents.

fallbacks.primary: Inter Tight, Sohne, DM Sans, system-ui, sans-serif

rules: Use Mori-style type as a single-family system.
Use weight 400 for body, nav, labels, cards, and most UI.
Use weight 600 for giant display, tool headings, and pill buttons.
Set hero display at 224px, line-height 0.9, -0.02em tracking.
Do not introduce serif or secondary display fonts.

shadows.none: Avoid drop shadows. Organic shapes are lit internally with gradients.

components.name: Outlined Cream Pill Button
components.recipe: Transparent fill, Surface Cream text, 1px Surface Cream border, 100px radius, 15px by 24px padding, Mori 18px/600.

components.name: Gradient-Stroked CTA Pill
components.recipe: Transparent fill, Surface Cream text, 1.5px to 2px green-to-light-green gradient stroke, 100px radius.

components.name: Ghost Nav Link
components.recipe: No background, no border, Surface Cream or Surface 50 text, Mori 16px/400, tight row gaps.

components.name: Borderless Icon Button
components.recipe: Round icon-only control, no visible background, cream icon, compact hit area.

components.name: Category Color Label
components.recipe: Mori 19px to 24px/400, single-word discipline name in fixed mapped color.

components.name: Curly-Bracket Annotation
components.recipe: Small Mori 16px to 19px/400 Surface Cream text wrapped in literal curly braces.

components.name: Hero Display Headline
components.recipe: Mori 224px/600, line-height 0.9, -0.02em tracking, Surface Cream, bleeding toward viewport edges.

components.name: Tool Feature Block
components.recipe: Two-column row with organic gradient illustration, category label, cream heading, body copy, outlined pill, and Surface 25 divider.

components.name: Organic Gradient Illustration
components.recipe: Soft 3D-like pill/blob/dome using discipline accent gradient, no frame, no drop shadow, loose overlap.

components.name: Showcase Card
components.recipe: Off Black or near-black surface, 8px radius, 24px padding, cream heading, contained preview, no visible border.

components.name: Announcement Banner
components.recipe: Full-bleed dark band with centered 14px Mori text in Surface Cream and optional green inline link.

components.name: Footer
components.recipe: Off Black footer with Surface 25 top divider, multi-column cream links, muted secondary text, and 60px to 80px vertical padding.

do: Use Surface Cream instead of pure white.
Use Just Black instead of pure black.
Use the fixed discipline color mapping consistently.
Reserve the gradient-stroked pill for the primary CTA.
Push the hero headline to 224px/600 with 0.9 line-height.
Use Surface 25 dividers between tool feature rows.
dont: Do not add filled solid CTA buttons.
Do not use pure white text or pure black background.
Do not reuse a discipline color for another discipline.
Do not use color as random decoration.
Do not center the hero inside a narrow max-width container.
Do not add drop shadows to organic shapes.
Do not introduce serif fonts or a second text family.
